title: PolyDB Out-of-Process Driver Broker
description: Contract for third-party database drivers that join polydb as out-of-process providers over the WebSocket async contract. Internal/built-in drivers (the closed DatabaseKind set) are untouched; a provider is identified by a namespaced key (§6.6 key namespacing K x P), declares its coeffects, and is registered/unregistered through tracked effects with a LIFO accumulator (§3.1).

DriverProviderKey.description: Namespaced provider key 'P:K' — P identifies the interface-defining package, K the driver kind. Eliminates key collision by construction (§6.6). Never equals a built-in DatabaseKind wire value.

DriverCapability.description: Capability bit a provider may request. The broker attenuates this set at interception time (§6.3): an untrusted provider is granted a subset, e.g. read-only query/metadata.

key.description: Unique namespaced key. A second provider claiming the same key is rejected (cannot provide twice, Def 19) — unless the provider declares commutative (Thm 47 witnessed coeffect): the key's service is instance-interchangeable, so multiple providers may serve it concurrently (§16.18).

kind.description: Wire name of the database dialect this provider speaks (e.g. 'duckdb'); informational, NOT a DatabaseKind enum value.

protocol_version.description: Version of the broker async contract the provider was built against; version probe precedes dereference (plugin-abi.md §2.3).

capabilities.description: Declared capability requests; the inject declaration is a capability request known before the component runs (§6.3).

commutative.description: Witnessed coeffect (Thm 47): the provider asserts its key is a commutative table — instances are interchangeable, requests may be served by any of them, and withdrawing one never disturbs the others. Enables multi-instance attachment and load balancing (§16.18); without it a second attach on the same key is a rolling update (replacement), not coexistence.

endpoint.description: Optional transport hint for the out-of-process channel (WS URL / stdio pipe name). Empty means the current WS connection is the bridge.

granted_capabilities.description: Effective capabilities after interception; a subset of capabilities. Changed at runtime without a reload (§6.3 in-place intercept update).

reliance.description: Number of in-flight operations bound to this provider. Non-zero reliance forbids withdrawal: the ¬ relied_n(γ) guard (Def 55).

DriverBrokerEvent.description: Classification of a context change by notify_d (Def 22). 'neutral' is a granted-capability change that satisfies the same declarations and therefore triggers no reload.
